items.label: High-quality Motion Sensor
items.value: Equipped with a high-performance motion sensor, this security light detects movement within a 180° range and up to 59 feet away. The adjustable lamp heads allow you to direct the light where it is needed, enhancing safety without disturbing your neighbors

items.label: Triple Operation Modes
items.value: Choose from three modes to fit your needs. On-Time mode offers manual control, Auto mode activates with motion at night, and Dusk-to-Dawn mode turns the light on at sunset and off at sunrise for hands-free security

items.label: Durable and Lasting
items.value: Built with a sturdy aluminum body, this light is designed for durability. It resists wear, dissipates heat efficiently, and withstands sun, rain, and snow, ensuring reliable operation year-round

items.label: Powerful and Versatile Illumination
items.value: With a 100-277V wide voltage range, this 25W security light delivers 2500 lumens of bright illumination, making it ideal for both residential and commercial applications

items.label: Reliable Quality
items.value: This security light is ETL certified for safety and reliability. With a 50,000-hour lifespan and a 3-year warranty, you can trust it to provide long-lasting performance and peace of mind

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: 100-277V for commercial use, 3 years warranty, ETL &FCC listed, Motion activated & dusk to dawn, Up to 50,000hrs lifespan
